WBFLOWNOTSIGNEDIN: You are not signed in to Pulse. The workbooks and the relationships between objects come from Pulse: sign in to see them.
WBFLOWSESSIONEXPIRED: Pulse refused the request: your Pulse session has expired. Sign in to Pulse again to continue.
WBFLOWLISTNEEDSSIGNIN: The workbook list appears once you are signed in to Pulse.
WBFLOWRELOAD: Reload the workbook list from Pulse
WBFLOWSIGNINTIP: Open Arc's Pulse sign-in; the page reloads once you are signed in
WBFLOWCUBESTIP: Cubes of this instance the workbook's worksheets read:
WBFLOWSHEETSSHOWTIP: Show each worksheet between the workbook and the cubes it reads
WBFLOWSHEETSHIDETIP: Hide the worksheets: link the workbook straight to its cubes
WBFLOWZOOMIN: Zoom in (or scroll up on the diagram)
WBFLOWZOOMOUT: Zoom out (or scroll down on the diagram)
WBFLOWSVGTIP: Download the diagram as an SVG file, with its icons
WBFLOWREDRAWTIP: Read the workbook and the relationships from Pulse again
WBFLOWGOTOTIP: Show the details of this object and highlight its links
WBFLOWOPENTIP: Open this object in a new Arc tab
WBFLOWNODETIP: Click: show the details and highlight the links
WBFLOWNODETIPOPEN: Click: show the details and highlight the links. Double-click: open in Arc
WBFLOWSEARCHTIP: Every word must appear in the workbook's name, path, last user or cubes
WBFLOWCHECKING: Finding the workbooks that use this instance:
WBFLOWCOUNTUSE: workbooks in Pulse use this instance
WBFLOWNOWORKBOOKS: Pulse has no Excel workbook opened in this period for this Pulse environment.
WBFLOWNONEFORINSTANCE: No workbook opened in this period reads a cube of this instance.
WBFLOWTRYLONGER: Choose a longer period to see more.
WBFLOWCOUNTUSEPERIOD: workbooks opened in this period use this instance
WBFLOWPERIODTIP: List the workbooks opened in this period
WBFLOWALLTIP: Draw every workbook in the list (as filtered by the search) in one diagram, at level 1
WBFLOWONETIP: Draw one workbook: the one you click in the list
WBFLOWNOTHINGALL: No workbook to draw: choose a longer period, or clear the search.
WBFLOWRECORDED: Sheets as Pulse recorded them when last opened:
WBFLOWRECORDEDTIP: Pulse records a workbook's sheets and the cubes they read when the workbook is opened with the Pulse add-in. A sheet added or renamed since then shows after the workbook is next opened.
WBFLOWPAPPLYTIP: List the workbooks opened between these two days
WBFLOWPNEEDDATES: Choose both days of the period.
WBFLOWPORDER: The first day must be on or before the last day.
WBFLOWDETAILFAILED: Pulse could not return the worksheets of:
WBFLOWBADANSWER: Pulse did not return a list of workbooks.
WBFLOWBADRELATION: Pulse did not return relationships for cube
WBFLOWOTHERSERVERS: This workbook also uses cubes on other TM1 instances, not drawn here (open this page on that instance):
WBFLOWNOCUBES: Pulse recorded no cube of this instance for this workbook's worksheets.
WBFLOWLESSTIP: Draw one level less of cube relationships
WBFLOWMORETIP: Draw one level more: the objects related to the cubes found in the last level
WBFLOWALLLEVELS: Every related cube is already drawn: another level would add nothing
WBFLOWLEVELSTIP: Level 1: the objects related to the workbook's cubes. Each level more follows the cubes found in the level before
WBFLOWFIT: Fit the diagram to the window
WBFLOWPICK: Pick a workbook on the left to draw its flow diagram.
WBFLOWBUILDING: Reading the workbook and the relationships from Pulse...
WBFLOWDSFAILED: The processes' data sources could not be read from TM1, so they are not drawn
WBFLOWHELP: Click an object to highlight its links, double-click a cube, process, dimension or chore to open it. Drag to move, scroll to zoom. Dashed lines: worksheet to cube, from Pulse's workbook tracking. Solid lines: relationships from Pulse's documentation. Dotted lines: a process's data source, from TM1.
